data.title: Road to Crisis · synthetic fixture
data.text: A storm has disrupted the fictional Lark commercial port. Relief access, trade and public confidence are uncertain. This is a strategic fixture inspired by DATE-style context, not an official DATE scenario.

data.title: Lark port · current condition
data.text: Established scenario baseline: commercial service is disrupted; access negotiations are ongoing. Aggregate availability and delay are analytic estimates, not tactical plans.

data.title: Actors and relationships
data.text: Aster offers relief support. Bellwether coordinates port access and trade. Both can communicate freely in this fixture; their promises do not establish execution.

data.title: World View · public account
data.text: Public reporting describes delayed relief and conflicting accounts of access readiness. Publication does not establish every player's awareness or belief.

data.title: Aster perspective · intelligence addition
data.text: ASTER PRIVATE: local sources question whether commercial access assurances cover relief support.

data.title: Bellwether perspective · intelligence addition
data.text: BELLWETHER PRIVATE: economic advisers expect public confidence to depend on credible access commitments.

data.title: Actual communication · reported agreement
data.text: Representatives communicated an access promise conditional on review. The communication and agreement occurred; access execution is not yet established.
